visualCharacteristics.purpose: list of press-release cards, each with a photo, headline, teaser and a link to the full release
visualCharacteristics.layout: three cards per row on desktop, two on tablet, one on mobile; equal-height cards with the link pinned to the bottom
visualCharacteristics.stylingNotes: White section; borderless cards with no tile background: full-width 4:3 photo, H3 headline, teaser paragraph, bottom-pinned tertiary 'Read the press release' text link with arrow

contentPattern.structure: one row per card: cell 1 image (4:3 photo); cell 2 text (H3 headline, teaser paragraph, CTA link)
contentPattern.reason: Repeating look-alike items that flow and wrap (3/2/1 per row) and each link to a detail page: a dynamic list, so Cards
contentPattern.variantReason: Borderless press/news cards: full-width 4:3 photo on top, H3 headline, teaser paragraph and a bottom-pinned tertiary text link with arrow, on white. Differs from cards-icon (small line icon in padded sky-blue tile) and cards-logo (image-only logos)

usage: Use for press-release, news or article listings where each card has a photo, headline, teaser and one link to the detail page.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for any photo-led article/news card list. Use cards-icon for icon tiles on a colored background and cards-logo for image-only logo grids.
